posts.title: TowerCity
posts.description: Our very own Renan has built and released this game inspired by the 1990s classic “SimTower.” It runs in the browser, and the goal is to build and manage a skyscraper.

posts.title: The Manual do Usuário app
posts.description: Manual do Usuário is an app, too, just not one from the app stores. Here’s how to install it, and why the drop in Google traffic makes it urgent.

posts.title: Cra and Search browsers
posts.description: Two new browsers, Cra and Search, popped up recently, thanks to a mix of open-source engines, vibe coding, and the shutdown of the Arc browser in December.
